name: Fel Domination
description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.

name: Summon Doomguard
description:
Summons a Doomguard to assist you in combat for 12 sec. Consuming a Demonic Core reduces the cooldown of Summon Doomguard by 3 sec.

 Doom Bolt Volley
Sends a volley of malefic bolts at 5 enemies within 40 yds, inflicting 1,562 Shadow damage to each target.

name: Dark Pact
description: Sacrifices 20% of your current health to shield you for 200% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 950 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.

name: Summon Demonic Tyrant
description: Summon a Demonic Tyrant that damages your target for 15 sec. \n\nDamage dealt by Demonic Tyrant is increased by 10% for each Wild Imp and Dreadstalker active.

name: Mortal Coil
description: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 20% of maximum health.

name: Call Dreadstalkers
description: Summons 2 ferocious Dreadstalkers to attack the target for 12 sec.

name: Demonic Gateway
description: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.

name: Soulburn
description:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.

name: Banish
description: Banishes an enemy Demon, Aberration, or Elemental, preventing any action for 30 sec. Limit 1. Casting Banish again on the target will cancel the effect.

name: Burning Rush
description: Increases your movement speed by 50%, but also damages you for 4% of your maximum health every 1 sec. Movement impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until canceled.

name: Curse of Exhaustion
description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.\n\nCurses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.

name: Curse of Tongues
description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 1 min.\n\nCurses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.

name: Demonic Circle
description:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.

name: Hand of Gul'dan
description: Calls down a demonic meteor full of Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target.\n\nDeals up to 570 Shadowflame damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summons 3 Wild Imps.

name: Summon Felguard
description: Summons a Felguard under your command as a powerful melee combatant.

name: Blight of Tongues
description: Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing their casting time of all spells by 100% for 12 sec.\n\nCurses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.

name: Blight of Weakness
description: Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing the time between their attacks by 100% and reducing their critical strike chance by 10% for 12 sec.\n\nCurses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.

name: Grimoire: Fel Ravager
description: Summons a Fel Ravager to assist you in combat for 20 sec and will purge 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy.\n\nTurns into Devour Magic while on cooldown.

name: Grimoire: Imp Lord
description: Summons an Imp Lord to assist you in combat for 20 sec and will remove 1 harmful effect from you when summoned. \n\nTransforms into Singe Magic while on cooldown.

name: Shadowfury
description: Stuns all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.

name: Howl of Terror
description: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Power Siphon
description: Instantly sacrifice up to 2 Wild Imps, generating 2 charges of Demonic Core that cause Demonbolt to deal 30% additional damage.

name: Implosion
description: Demonic forces suck 6 of your Wild Imps toward the target, and then cause them to violently explode, dealing 510 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

name: Ritual of Doom
description: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual.

name: Soulstone
description: Stores the soul of the target party or raid member, allowing resurrection upon death. Targets resurrect with 60% health and at least 20% mana.

name: Unending Resolve
description: Hardens your skin, reducing all damage you take by 25% and granting immunity to interrupt, silence, and pushback effects for 8 sec.

name: Create Soulwell
description: Creates a Soulwell for 2 min. Party and raid members can use the Soulwell to acquire a Healthstone.

name: Ritual of Summoning
description: Begins a ritual to create a summoning portal, requiring the caster and 2 allies to complete. This portal can be used to summon party and raid members.

name: Thal'kiel's Consumption
description: Thal'kiel drains 8% of the life from your demon servants and unleashes a blast of Shadow damage at your current target equal to the life he stole.

name: Reap Souls
description: Consume all Tormented Souls collected by Ulthalesh, increasing your damage by 10% and doubling the effect of all of Ulthalesh's other traits for 5 sec per soul consumed.\n\nUlthalesh collects Tormented Souls from each target you kill and occasionally escaped souls it previously collected.

name: Chaos Barrage
description: Deals 52 Chaos damage.

name: Chaos Bolt
description: Unleashes a devastating blast of chaos, causing 760 Chaos damage. Chaos Bolt always critically strikes and your critical strike chance increases its damage.

name: Command Demon
description:
Commands your demon to perform its most powerful ability. This spell will transform based on your active pet. 

Felhunter: Spell Lock
Voidwalker: Shadow Bulwark
Incubus/Succubus: Seduction
Imp: Singe Magic

name: Control Demon
description: Summons a Voidwalker under your command, able to withstand heavy punishment.

name: Corruption
description: Corrupts the target, causing 134 Shadow damage and an additional 985 Shadow damage over 14 sec.

name: Create Healthstone
description: Creates a Healthstone that can be consumed to restore 25% health.

name: Curse of Weakness
description: Increases the time between an enemy's attacks by 20% for 2 min.\n\nCurses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.

name: Dimensional Rift
description: Rips a hole in time and space, opening a portal that damages your target.\n\nGenerates 3 Soul Shard Fragments.

name: Drain Life
description: Drains life from the target, causing 1,140 Shadow damage over 4.5 sec, and healing you for 500% of the damage done.

name: Dreadsteed
description: Summons a Dreadsteed, which serves as a mount.

name: Eye of Kilrogg
description: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye is stealthed and moves quickly but is very fragile.

name: Fear
description: Strikes fear in the enemy, disorienting for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1.

name: Felsteed
description: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount.

name: Shadow Bolt
description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 651 Shadow damage.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Soul Leech
description: All single-target damage done by you and your minions grants you and your pet shadowy shields that absorb 3% of the damage dealt for 15 sec, up to 5% of maximum health.

name: Subjugate Demon
description: Subjugates the target demon up to level 71, forcing it to do your bidding for 10 min.

name: Summon Felhunter
description: Summons a Felhunter under your command, able to disrupt the spell casts of your enemies.

name: Summon Imp
description: Summons an Imp under your command that casts ranged Firebolts.

name: Summon Sayaad
description: Summons a Succubus or Incubus under your command to seduce enemy Humanoids, preventing them from attacking.

name: Summon Voidwalker
description: Summons a Voidwalker under your command, able to withstand heavy punishment.

name: Unending Breath
description: Allows an ally to breathe underwater and increases swim speed by 20% for 10 min.

name: Call Fel Lord
description: Summon a fel lord to guard the location for 15 sec. Any enemy that comes within 6 yards will suffer 760 Physical damage, and players struck will be stunned for 1 sec.

name: Shadow Rift
description: Conjure a Shadow Rift at the target location lasting 2 sec. Enemy players within the rift when it expires are teleported to your Demonic Circle.\n\nMust be within 40 yds of your Demonic Circle to cast.

name: Soul Rip
description: Fracture the soul of up to 3 target players within 20 yds into the shadows, reducing their damage done by 25% and healing received by 25% for 8 sec. Souls are fractured up to 20 yds from the player's location.\n\nPlayers can retrieve their souls to remove this effect.

name: Nether Ward
description: Surrounds the caster with a shield that lasts 3 sec, reflecting all harmful spells cast on you.

name: Bonds of Fel
description: Encircle enemy players with Bonds of Fel. If any affected player leaves the 8 yd radius they explode, dealing 2,737 Fire damage split amongst all nearby enemies.

name: Bloodstones
description: Your Healthstones are replaced with Bloodstones which increase their user's haste by 20% for 12 sec instead of healing.

name: Gateway Mastery
description: Increases the range of your Demonic Gateway by 20 yards, and reduces the cast time by 30%. Reduces the time between how often players can take your Demonic Gateway by 30 sec.

name: Impish Instincts
description: Taking direct Physical damage reduces the cooldown of Demonic Circle by 3 sec.\n\nCannot occur more than once every 5 sec.

name: Abyss Walker
description: Using Demonic Circle: Teleport or your Demonic Gateway reduces all damage you take by 4% for 10 sec.

name: Abyssal Dominion
description: Summon Infernal becomes empowered, dealing 40% increased damage. When your Summon Infernal ends, it fragments into two smaller Infernals at 50% effectiveness that lasts 10 sec.

name: Annihilan's Bellow
description: Howl of Terror cooldown is reduced by 10 sec and range is increased by 5 yds.

name: Antoran Armaments
description:
Your Demonic Tyrant is equipped with armor forged within Antorus, increasing their armor by 10%. While summoned, your Demonic Tyrant now assaults enemies with powerful melee attacks.

 Burning Cleave
Cleaves all enemies in a cone in front of the caster, inflicting 368 Shadowflame damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Blighted Maw
description: The fangs of your Dreadstalkers are coated in corrosive bile, causing Dreadbite to deal additional damage equal to 50% of damage dealt as Plague damage.

name: Carnivorous Stalkers
description: Your Dreadstalkers' attacks have a 10% chance to trigger an additional Dreadbite.

name: Cloven Souls
description: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.

name: Cruelty of Kerxan
description: Summon Infernal grants Diabolic Ritual and reduces its duration by 3 sec.

name: Dark Accord
description: Reduces the cooldown of Unending Resolve by 45 sec.

name: Demon Skin
description: Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 5% of maximum health.\n\nIncreases your armor by 45%.

name: Demoniac
description:
Grants access to the following abilities:

 Demonbolt
Send the fiery soul of a fallen demon at the enemy, causing 1,537 Shadowflame damage.

 Demonic Core
When your Wild Imps fade or are imploded, you have a 10% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core. 

When your summoned Dreadstalkers fade away, you have a 100% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core.

Demonic Core reduces the cast time of Demonbolt by 100%. Maximum 4 stacks.

name: Demoniac's Fervor
description: Your demonic soul deals 100% increased damage to the main target of Hand of Gul'dan.

name: Demonic Brutality
description: Damaging critical strikes dealt by you and your demons deal 230% damage instead of the usual 200%.

name: Demonic Calling
description: Call Dreadstalkers costs 1 less Soul Shard and its cast time is reduced by 50%.

name: Demonic Embrace
description: Stamina increased by 10%.

name: Demonic Fortitude
description: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.

name: Demonic Knowledge
description: Hand of Gul'dan has a 5% chance to generate a charge of Demonic Core.

name: Demonic Resilience
description: Reduces the chance you will be critically struck by 2%. All damage your primary demon takes is reduced by 8%.

name: Demonic Soul
description: A demonic entity now inhabits your soul, allowing you to detect if a Soul Shard has a Succulent Soul when it's generated.\n\nConsuming a Succulent Soul unleashes your demonic soul, dealing 1,342 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Diabolic Oculi
description: You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.\n\nDiabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing 891 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Diabolic Ritual
description: Casting Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. If Diabolic Ritual is already active, its duration is reduced by 1 sec instead.\n\nWhen Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.

name: Dominant Hand
description: Increases damage dealt by Hand of Gul'dan to its main target by 20%.

name: Dominion of Argus
description: Summoning your Demonic Tyrant leaves open a portal to Argus for 15 sec, causing every 2 casts of Hand of Gul'dan to summon a subjugated demon that serves you for 10 sec.

name: Doom
description: When Demonbolt consumes a Demonic Core it inflicts impending doom upon the target, dealing 1,531 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds of its target after 20 sec or when removed. Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.\n\nHand of Gul'dan reduces the duration of Doom by 3 sec.

name: Dreadlash
description: When your Dreadstalkers charge into battle, their Dreadbite attack now hits all targets within 8 yards and deals 10% more damage.

name: Empowered Drain Life
description: Drain Life heals for an additional 200% of damage dealt and grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of damage dealt.

name: Empowered Felstorm
description: Increases the damage of your Felguard's Felstorm by 20% and its duration by 4.0 sec.

name: Empowered Healthstone
description: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.

name: Eternal Hunger
description: Increases the duration of Manifested Avarice by 5 sec and increases the damage of Soul Swipe by 10%.

name: Eternal Servitude
description: Fel Domination cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.

name: Feast of Souls
description: When you kill a target, you have a chance to generate a Soul Shard that is guaranteed to be a Succulent Soul.

name: Fel Armaments
description: The cooldown of your Felguard's Felstorm is reduced by 10 sec and damage dealt to your primary demon is reduced by 10%.

name: Fel Armor
description: When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 5% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.\n\nReduces damage taken by 1.5%.

name: Fel Intellect
description: Increases your Intellect by 2%.

name: Fel Pact
description: Reduces the cooldown of Fel Domination by 60 sec.

name: Fel Synergy
description: Soul Leech also heals you for 8% and your pet for 25% of the absorption it grants.

name: Fiendish Stride
description: Reduces the damage dealt by Burning Rush by 10%. Burning Rush increases your movement speed by an additional 20%.

name: Flames of Xoroth
description: Fire damage increased by 4% and damage dealt by your demons is increased by 4%.

name: Flametouched
description: Increases the attack speed of your Dreadstalkers by 10% and their critical strike chance by 15%.

name: Fortified Soul
description: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.

name: Foul Mouth
description: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.

name: Frequent Donor
description: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.

name: Frequent Traveler
description: Reduces the cast time of Demonic Gateway by 0.5 sec and you can now use Demonic Gateways twice before triggering a cooldown.

name: Friends In Dark Places
description: Dark Pact now shields you for an additional 50% of the sacrificed health.

name: Gloom of Nathreza
description: Enemies marked by your Havoc take 7% increased damage from your single target spells.

name: Gorebound Fortitude
description: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when consuming a Healthstone, increasing its healing by 30% and increasing your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.

name: Gorefiend's Avarice
description: Drain Life now channels 100% faster and restores health 100% faster.

name: Gorefiend's Resolve
description: Targets resurrected with Soulstone resurrect with 40% additional health and 80% additional mana.

name: Hellbent Commander
description: Your demons deal 1.0% increased damage for each demon you control.

name: Horrify
description: Your Fear causes the target to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.

name: Ichor of Devils
description: Dark Pact sacrifices only 5% of your current health for the same shield value.

name: Imp Gang Boss
description: Hand of Gul'dan now empowers 1 of the Wild Imps it summons, increasing its damage dealt by 100%.

name: Imp-erator
description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Wild Imp's Fel Firebolt by 15%.

name: Improved Demonic Tactics
description: Increases the critical strike chance of your primary demon by 50% of your critical strike chance.

name: Improved Mortal Coil
description: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.

name: Infernal Beneficiary
description: Healing done by Drain Life also heals your primary demon at 400% effectiveness.

name: Infernal Bulwark
description: Unending Resolve grants Soul Leech equal to 10% of your maximum health and increases the maximum amount Soul Leech can absorb by 10% for 8 sec.

name: Infernal Machine
description: Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Infernal is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.

name: Infernal Rapidity
description: When your Wild Imps cast Fel Firebolt, they have 10% chance to instantly cast another Fel Firebolt at 200% effectiveness.

name: Infernal Vitality
description: Unending Resolve heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 10 sec.

name: Inner Demons
description: You passively summon a Wild Imp to fight for you every 12 sec.

name: Looks That Kill
description:
Your Diabolic Oculi now cast Diabolic Gaze at your primary demon's target every 1 sec while active.

 Diabolic Gaze
Fire a beam of destructive chaos magic at the target, dealing 304 Chaos damage.

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.

name: Manifested Avarice
description:
Each Succulent Soul consumed has an increasing chance to unleash the Demonic Soul within you, enabling it to assault your enemies for 9 sec.

 Soul Swipe
Strikes nearby enemies with a malevolent claw, dealing 742 Shadow damage to its target and 495 Shadow damage to other enemies in 10 yds.

name: Mark of F'harg
description:
Your Summon Vilefiend becomes Summon Charhound and learns the following ability:

 Infernal Presence
Cloaked in the ever-burning flames of the abyss, dealing 60 Fire damage to enemies within 10 yards every 0.9 sec.

name: Mark of Shatug
description:
Your Summon Vilefiend becomes Summon Gloomhound and learns the following ability:

 Gloom Slash
Tooth and claw are drenched in malignant shadow magic, causing the Gloomhound's melee attacks to deal an additional 120 Shadow damage.

name: Master Summoner
description: Increases Mastery by 3% and reduces the cast time of your Summon Demonic Tyrant and Summon Felguard by 0.5 sec.

name: Mind's Eyes
description: Your Diabolic Oculi observe the battlefield and collect information that is imparted to you upon being exploded, each Diabolic Oculi increasing your Intellect by 2% for 10 sec.

name: Necrolyte Teachings
description: Shadow Bolt damage increased by 20%. Power Siphon increases the damage of Demonbolt by an additional 20%.

name: Nightmare
description: Increases the amount of damage required to break your fear effects by 60%.

name: Oppressive Darkness
description: Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.\n\nReduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.

name: Pact of Gluttony
description:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 25% health. 60 sec cooldown.

name: Pact of the Annihilan
description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.

name: Pact of the Eredar
description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.

name: Pact of the Nathrezim
description: Increases your Leech by 2%.

name: Pact of the Satyr
description: Increases your haste by 2%.

name: Practiced Rituals
description: Increases your Mastery by 2%.

name: Quietus
description: Soul Anathema damage increased by 25% and is dealt 20% faster.\n\nConsuming Demonic Core activates Shared Fate or Feast of Souls.

name: Reign of Tyranny
description: Your Demonic Tyrant lasts an additional 5 sec and extends the duration of your Dreadstalkers by 15 sec when summoned.

name: Ruination
description:
Summoning a Pit Lord causes your next Chaos Bolt to become Ruination.

 Ruination
Call down a demon-infested meteor from the depths of the Twisting Nether, dealing 9,644 Chaos damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summoning 3 Wild Imps.

Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Rune of Shadows
description: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 10% and increases its damage by 15%.

name: Sacrificed Souls
description: Shadow Bolt and Demonbolt deal 2% additional damage per demon you have summoned.

name: Sataiel's Volition
description: Wild Imp damage increased by 35% and Wild Imps that are imploded have an additional 5% chance to grant a Demonic Core.

name: Secrets of the Coven
description:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Incinerate to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 5,119 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 3 Soul Shards.

name: Shadow of Death
description: Your Summon Demonic Tyrant spell is empowered by the demonic entity within you, causing it to grant 3 Soul Shards that each contain a Succulent Soul.

name: Shared Fate
description: When you kill a target, its tortured soul is flung into a nearby enemy for 3 sec. This effect inflicts 191 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds every 0.9 sec.\n\nDeals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Shared Vessel
description: Increases your Mastery by 2%.\n\nThis effect is doubled while the demonic entity is aiding you in combat.

name: Soul Anathema
description: Unleashing your demonic soul bestows a fiendish entity unto the soul of its targets, dealing 488 Shadow damage over 10 sec.\n\nIf this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Soul Anathema.

name: Soul Link
description: 5% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. \n\nWhile Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 3%.

name: Soul-Etched Circles
description: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when casting Demonic Circle: Teleport, increasing your movement speed by 50% and making you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

name: Spiteful Reconstitution
description: Increases Demonbolt damage by 10% and consuming a Demonic Core has a chance to summon a Wild Imp.

name: Stabilized Portals
description: Increases the duration of your Summon Vilefiend, Grimoire: Imp Lord, and Grimoire: Fel Ravager by 3 sec.

name: Strength of Will
description: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.

name: Summon Vilefiend
description: Call Dreadstalkers also summons a Vilefiend that assists you in combat for 15 sec.

name: Swift Artifice
description: Reduces the cast time of Soulstone and Create Healthstone by 50%.

name: Teachings of the Black Harvest
description:
Your primary pets gain a bonus effect.

Imp: Successful Singe Magic casts grant the target 4% damage reduction for 5 sec.

Voidwalker: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Bulwark by 30 sec.

Felhunter: Reduces the cooldown of Devour Magic by 5 sec.

Sayaad: Reduces the cooldown of Seduction by 10 sec and causes the target to walk faster towards the demon.

name: To Hell and Back
description:
Power Siphon and Implosion summon 1 Imp Gang Boss for every 2 Wild Imps sacrificed. Wild Imps summoned this way gain Unstable Soul.

 Unstable Soul
Increases damage done by 50% and Fel Firebolt now jumps to 4 additional targets.

name: Touch of Rancora
description: Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.\n\nCasting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.

name: Tyrant's Oblation
description: Your Demonic Tyrant also empowers you while active, increasing your haste by 8%.

name: Wicked Reaping
description: Damage dealt by your demonic soul is increased by 10%.\n\nConsuming Demonic Core feeds the demonic entity within you, causing it to appear and deal 914 Shadow damage to your target.

name: Demonic Circle: Teleport
description: Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.

description:
